1.explanation: To reproduce and fix this accessibility issue, you need to review how FormGroup and RadioButtonGroup render their <fieldset> and <legend> internally (FormGroup/FormGroup.mdx and RadioButtonGroup/RadioButtonGroup.mdx). The legend’s styling and behavior come from the FormLabel component (FormLabel/FormLabel.mdx). The individual radio buttons within the group are defined in RadioButton (RadioButton/RadioButton.mdx) and its migration notes (RadioButton/migrate-to-7.x.md) may highlight API changes around passing props. Finally, the overarching Form documentation (Form/Form.mdx) shows how FormGroup is used in context. Together, these files cover how to expose a custom id on the legend and sync it with aria-labelledby on the fieldset to fulfill the a11y requirement.
1.bug_scenario: The user is rendering a group of radio buttons inside a settings menu (extended Carbon DataTable) and needs to have proper accessibility support by connecting the <legend> element’s id with the parent <fieldset>’s aria-labelledby attribute. In the current implementation of both FormGroup and RadioButtonGroup, there is no way to pass a custom id onto the <legend> (nor to have the <fieldset> pick up that same id via aria-labelledby). The screenshot shows the intended markup: a <fieldset class="bx--radio-button-group…" aria-labelledby="row-height-label"> wrapping a <legend class="bx--label" id="row-height-label">Row height</legend> so that screen readers announce the legend as the group label.
